LESSON: STORY TELLING

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: LITERACY ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.2: Story Telling

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Story Telling. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. acquire and accurately use appropriate words 172 and phrases from stories retell stories in pairs, groups and whole class
2. develop an interest in telling stories for pleasure
3. demonstrate techniques of effective storytelling

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. acquire and accurately use appropriate words 172 and phrases from stories retell stories in pairs, groups and whole class
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to acquire and accurately use appropriate words 172 and phrases from stories retell stories in pairs, groups and whole class. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. develop an interest in telling stories for pleasure
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to develop an interest in telling stories for pleasure. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. demonstrate techniques of effective storytelling
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to demonstrate techniques of effective storytelling. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Story Telling using something you see at school.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Story Telling.
2. Explain Story Telling to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Story Telling.
4. Show that you can: acquire and accurately use appropriate words 172 and phrases from stories retell stories in pairs, groups and whole class
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Story Telling. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Story Telling important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. acquire and accurately use appropriate words 172 and phrases from stories retell stories in pairs, groups and whole class
2. develop an interest in telling stories for pleasure
3. demonstrate techniques of effective storytelling

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
